text:
Ivy (CS): Clearview Health pushed back the vendor questionnaire. Key asks: do we support BYOK for hosted? how long do embeddings live? and do non-prod backups contain customer vectors?

Diego (Security): Short answers: hosted = managed KMS by default; BYOK supported on Dedicated/Private. Embeddings: default retention 90d, can shorten on request; non-prod backups exclude live tenant vectors.

Priya (Eng): We can set per-tenant lifecycle to 30d on request. I'll prepare the S3 lifecycle snippet and a short audit log showing no tenant data in non-prod snapshots.

Ivy (CS): Can we deliver a 1-page summary + config snippets by EOD tomorrow? Customer says procurement needs it to clear renewal hold.

Ola (Acct Exec): If they mandate BYOK for hosted, that's a deal blocker. I'll offer a 30-day Dedicated trial + a security call to mitigate.

Diego (Security): I'll attach the KMS attestation and a paragraph about key provenance and rotation. Also note: backups encrypted with AES-256; rotation policy 90d.

DocBot: `DOC` uploaded: kma-attestation.pdf by diego at 3290012378 :white_check_mark:

Priya (Eng): Lifecycle rule applied to test bucket (proof): 3290012399. Snippet ready.

Ivy (CS): Draft to customer: "Thanks — attached is a short security summary: KMS options, embedding retention options (we can set 30/60/90d), and confirmation non-prod backups do not include live vectors. Happy to walk through on a 30-min call. Please advise preferred times."

Ola (Acct Exec): :thumbsup: I'll coordinate times and note renewal-risk:low if we can confirm 30-day lifecycle.

Ivy (CS): Great — I'll send once Diego and Priya confirm attachments. Tracking renewal flag until BYOK decision.
